analysis.summary: Found a high-severity bug in the regular expression logic for Italian VAT validation that will block personal profile updates.

bugs.title: Malformed Regex for Italian VAT Validation
bugs.description: The regular expression `/^{\d}16/` used for Italian VAT/Tax ID validation is syntactically and logically incorrect. It matches the literal characters '{', a digit, '}', and '16' instead of using a quantifier like `\d{16}` or `[A-Z0-9]{16}` (the standard for Italian Codice Fiscale).
bugs.risk: This functional bug will cause the validation to consistently return false for any real input. Consequently, Italian users with personal accounts will be unable to save or update their profile information as the UI and BFF will reject valid tax identifiers.

notBugs.reason: The UI applies validation conditionally based on the 'isSME' flag, whereas the BFF applies both validators as an OR condition. While slightly inconsistent, the BFF logic serves as a permissive fallback and does not cause a runtime failure or incorrect blocking of valid data.
The utility currently only handles 'it-IT'. The presence of a 'todo' comment suggests this is a phased rollout or a market-specific requirement, which is expected behavior for a feature branch.
